piezas.titulo: Vocabulary: Schedules, appointments and weekly routine
texto: Essential vocabulary for managing time and the daily agenda: «ตารางเวลา» (dtaa-raang wee-laa, schedule / timetable), «นัด» (nát, appointment / planned meeting), «เช้า» (cháao, morning / early hours of the day) and «สัปดาห์» (sàp-daa or sàp-bpà-daa, week). To arrange meetings, «มีนัด» (to have an appointment) or «นัดพบ» (to arrange to meet) is used. To mark immediate or future plans, the prospective aspect particle «จะ» (jà, going to / future) is placed before the verb: «พรุ่งนี้ฉันจะไปพบหมอ» (Tomorrow I'm going to see the doctor). To indicate a completed action, use «แล้ว» (lɛ́ɛo, already): «ฉันทำงานเสร็จแล้ว» (I've already finished work).
